summary: OCHA reports more than 220 olive trees vandalized in six incidents and additional settler property/livestock damage in twelve incidents.
discovery_sources: OCHA Protection of Civilians 14-27 Mar 2023; WAFA 17 Mar 2023 Husan tree destruction; PLO NAD Monthly Report March 2023; Times of Israel/Yesh Din Mar 3 2023 Burin incident; canonical Google Sheet dedup check
resolution_notes: Canonical dedup still resolves Husan as ILPV-2023-0322 and As Sawiya/Yasuf as ILPV-2023-0324. This run adds a negative exclusion: the readily surfaced Burin/Yesh Din incident reported by Times of Israel and NAD is dated Mar.3, outside OCHA's Mar.14-27 window, so it must not be used as the Burin component. NAD's March monthly search surfaces that Mar.3 Burin tree-damage entry but no matching later Burin event in the OCHA window. OCHA still reports six incidents while naming seven localities; Sinjil/Burin/Al Ganoub/Halhul/Deir Istiya remain unmapped absent direct event-level sources.
media_status: No exact-media attachment added; the Mar.3 Burin video is explicitly excluded from this aggregate because it is outside the OCHA window. No generic or related imagery used.
